tooltips.fieldKey: Meta's field slug as it came in on field_data[].name. Kept independently of the Question link so display survives schema deletions in Meta.
tooltips.label: Question label denormalised at ingest time. Lets the row keep rendering even if the parent Question is later soft-deleted.
tooltips.value: Display-ready value. For choice questions, the option's human label resolved via the parent question's options dictionary.
tooltips.valueRaw: Original array<string> Meta returned. Preserves option keys and multi-select fidelity.
tooltips.wasMapped: True when LeadFieldMapper consumed this field into a Contact attribute (email, phone, name, …). False = qualification-only.
